summary: R122-based German Paper 16 source-audit webdrop for printed pp.25-30. It applies one source-certain fix on printed p29, formula [7] and following prose, changing erroneous c-coefficients to the source alpha-coefficients.
verification_summary: Checked Paper 16 printed pp.25-30 against staged IA JP2-derived native page images.
Confirmed one source-certain fix: formula [7] and following prose use alpha coefficients, not c coefficients.
Pages 25-28 and 30 are recorded as no-new-patch in this pass.
XeLaTeX produced a 457-page German cumulative candidate PDF after rerun cleanup according to the included logbook.
limitations: Candidate review package only; not a promoted canonical branch unless later accepted/reconciled.
The source images are best staged local witnesses with ambiguous DPI metadata and are not claimed as strict 650+ native PPI witnesses.
Paper 16 printed pp.25-30 only; does not certify surrounding Noether papers or downstream translations.
No English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, or Interslavic synchronization is included.
Not a critical edition, not whole-corpus certification, and not final Noether closure.
recommended_next_action: Review and reconcile the alpha-coefficient correction into the current German branch before multilingual propagation; retain page-disposition CSVs as no-duplicate/source-audit guardrails.
github_note: Corrections and source comparisons can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
